description: Utility module providing functions to normalize project IDs, parse dates, and enrich deployment documents with projectId and updatedAt fields.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string id, handling strings, numbers, objects with nested projectId fields, and ObjectId-like objects.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updatedAt date from a document's fields or its _id's timestamp.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Enriches a deployment-like document with normalized projectId and updatedAt fields.
